squares.label: Safety Car
squares.description: A full safety car is deployed at any point in the race.

squares.label: VSC
squares.description: A Virtual Safety Car period is called.

squares.label: Race Ends Behind Safety Car
squares.description: The chequered flag falls with the safety car still leading the field.

squares.label: Red Flag
squares.description: The race is red-flagged and stopped.

squares.label: Standing Restart
squares.description: The race is restarted from a standing grid after a stoppage.

squares.label: Debris Yellow
squares.description: A local yellow or VSC specifically for debris on track.

squares.label: Marshal Sprints Across Track
squares.description: Marshals dash out to clear debris.

squares.label: Double Stack Pit Stop
squares.description: A team pits both cars on the same lap, one behind the other.

squares.label: Unsafe Release
squares.description: A car is released into the path of another in the pit lane (penalty or investigation).

squares.label: Fire in the Pit Box
squares.description: Flames or a fire extinguisher in a pit box during a stop.

squares.label: Lap 1 Contact
squares.description: Any contact between cars on the opening lap.

squares.label: Front Wing Change
squares.description: A car pits for a new nose after damage.

squares.label: Track Limits Lap Deleted
squares.description: A lap time is deleted for track limits during the race.

squares.label: 5-Second Penalty
squares.description: Any driver receives a 5-second time penalty.

squares.label: 10-Second Penalty
squares.description: Any driver receives a 10-second penalty or worse (drive-through, stop-go).

squares.label: Verdict After the Race
squares.description: Penalty investigation is postponed until after the race.

squares.label: Blue Flags Ignored
squares.description: A driver being lapped is slow to move aside and the booth notices.

squares.label: Retirement Before Lap 10
squares.description: Any car is out of the race within the first ten laps.

squares.label: Nobody Retires
squares.description: Every car that started the race is still running at the chequered flag.

squares.label: Double DNF for One Team
squares.description: Both cars from the same team fail to finish.

squares.label: Power Unit Failure
squares.description: A retirement attributed on air to the new power unit (ICE, battery, or electrics).

squares.label: Rain Starts Falling
squares.description: Rain reaches the circuit during the race, wherever on the track.

squares.label: Rain Never Arrives
squares.description: Rain is forecast or radar-watched on air, but the race stays dry.

squares.label: Rain Tyres Fitted
squares.description: At least one car fits intermediate or full wet tyres during the race.

squares.label: Photo Finish Under 0.5s
squares.description: The top two are separated by less than half a second at the line.

squares.label: Winner Started Outside Top 3
squares.description: The race winner started from fourth on the grid or further back.

squares.label: Rookie on the Podium
squares.description: A driver in their first full season finishes in the top three.

squares.label: Lead Changes Hands on Track
squares.description: The race lead changes hands on track rather than through the pit stops.

squares.label: "That Was Dangerous"
squares.description: A driver complains that a rival's move was dangerous.

squares.label: "Tyres Are Dead"
squares.description: A driver declares their tyres gone/dead/finished.

squares.label: Sarcastic Radio Reply
squares.description: A driver answers the pit wall with pure sarcasm.

squares.label: Engineer Says "We're Looking"
squares.description: The classic stalling answer: "we're looking into it", "we'll come back to you".

squares.label: "Who's Behind Me?"
squares.description: A driver has to ask who they're racing.

squares.label: "Copy" and Nothing Else
squares.description: A driver's entire response to bad news is "copy".

squares.label: Driver Refuses Team Order
squares.description: A driver is told to hold position or swap places, and audibly does not comply.

squares.label: Hammertime
squares.description: Hamilton gets (or references) the "Hammertime" call.

squares.label: Full Beans
squares.description: Any driver or engineer says "full beans".

squares.label: "Grazie Ragazzi"
squares.description: Ferrari radio victory/celebration in Italian on the world feed.

squares.label: Max Complains About the Car
squares.description: Verstappen critiques balance, energy, or strategy on the radio.

squares.label: 2 Secs Ted
squares.description: Ted Kravitz gets interrupted mid-sentence by driver comms or the director.

squares.label: Crofty's Silly Stat
squares.description: Crofty delivers a statistic nobody needed.

squares.label: Alonso Age Stat
squares.description: A statistic about Alonso's age or career length airs.

squares.label: TV Cuts Away From Battle
squares.description: The director cuts away from a live on-track fight to show something else.

squares.label: Replay Shown 3+ Times
squares.description: The same incident replayed at least three times.

squares.label: Steward Decision Baffles Booth
squares.description: Commentary is openly confused by a stewards' ruling.

squares.label: Home Hero Hyped
squares.description: The local driver's every move gets outsized coverage.

squares.label: Padel or Golf Mention
squares.description: Somebody mentions drivers' padel/golf hobbies on air.

squares.label: Pit Window Mentioned
squares.description: Commentary talks about a driver's pit window opening or closing.

squares.label: Sparks From the Skid Block
squares.description: Showers of sparks off a car's skid block, in a replay or on an onboard.

squares.label: Tyre Blistering Close-Up
squares.description: The broadcast shows a close-up of a blistered or grained tyre surface.

squares.label: Onboard Shows Bouncing
squares.description: An onboard camera makes the car's porpoising or bouncing obvious.

squares.label: Manual Override Explained
squares.description: Commentary explains the 2026 manual override boost as somebody uses it.

squares.label: 2026 Regs Re-Explained
squares.description: The booth stops to re-explain a 2026 rule the audience is assumed to have missed.

squares.label: Papaya Rules
squares.description: Broadcasters bring up "Papaya Rules".

squares.label: Fred Vasseur Laughs It Off
squares.description: Ferrari's boss deflects a crisis question with a chuckle.

squares.label: Strategist Head in Hands
squares.description: A pit wall strategist shown with head in hands.

squares.label: Typical Ferrari
squares.description: Ferrari makes a questionable strategy call.

squares.label: Cadillac Not Last
squares.description: Either Cadillac finishes ahead of a pre-2026 team's car.

squares.label: Both Cadillacs in the Points
squares.description: Cadillac finishes the race with both cars in the top ten.

squares.label: George Russell Bad Luck
squares.description: Russell loses a result to something outside his control — reliability, strategy, or someone else's mess.

squares.label: 2021 Nostalgia
squares.description: Max and Lewis battle it out.

squares.label: Driver Girlfriend in Garage
squares.description: Camera cuts to a driver's partner reacting in the garage.

squares.label: Driver's Dad Looks Nervous
squares.description: A driver's parent shown mid-anxiety.

squares.label: A-List Celeb in the Garage
squares.description: A genuinely famous person shown in a team's garage.

squares.label: Kid With Ear Defenders
squares.description: A child in ear defenders shown in the garage or grandstand.

squares.label: Trophy Handled Badly
squares.description: A trophy is dropped, broken, or awkwardly juggled on the podium.

squares.label: Orange Smoke in Grandstand
squares.description: Verstappen fans light flares/smoke.

squares.label: Empty Grandstand Shown
squares.description: The camera lingers on visibly empty seats.

squares.label: Crowd Boos on the Podium
squares.description: Audible booing during the podium ceremony.

squares.label: Mexican Wave in the Stands
squares.description: The crowd starts a wave and the director cuts to it.
